---
name: Week one feedback
about: The one week questionnaire. Fill this in after using BrotherMode on one real piece of work for a week, then submit it.
title: "[Week one feedback] "
labels: feedback, week-one
---

See `docs/FEEDBACK.md` for the full context behind this questionnaire.
Answer every question you can. Scale questions run 1 to 5, both ends are
labeled in words. Skip a question only if it truly does not apply, and say
why, right under the question.

## Install

**1. Did the install work on the first try?**
(Scale 1 to 5. 1: did not work, I could not get it running at all. 5: worked
exactly as the instructions said, no snags.)

Answer:

**2. Where, if anywhere, did you hesitate or get stuck during install?**
Quote the exact step or line if you can.

Answer:

**3. Roughly how long did install take, start to finish?**
Your best estimate is fine.

Answer:

## The first fifteen minutes

**4. Once it was installed, did you know what to do next?**
(Scale 1 to 5. 1: no idea, I was guessing. 5: completely obvious what to do
next.)

Answer:

**5. What did you expect to happen in the first fifteen minutes that did not
happen?**

Answer:

## Real use

**6. What did you actually use it for this week?**
Describe the real piece of work, in your own words.

Answer:

**7. Was there anything you tried using it for and then stopped?**
What was it, and why did you stop?

Answer:

## The safety story

**8. Did you ever see it refuse to do something, or stop and ask before
going ahead?**
If yes, describe what happened, as exactly as you can remember it.

Answer:

**9. If it refused or stopped you at any point, how much did you trust the
reason it gave?**
(Scale 1 to 5. 1: did not trust it, felt like it was just in my way. 5:
trusted it completely, the reason made sense. Leave blank if question 8
never happened to you.)

Answer:

**10. Did that refusal, if any, change how you worked, for better or
worse?**

Answer:

## The writing

**11. How did the tone of what it wrote to you feel, overall?**
(Scale 1 to 5. 1: confusing or condescending. 5: clear and respectful
throughout.)

Answer:

**12. Quote one sentence, if you can find one, that was confusing, wrong, or
that talked down to you.**

Answer:

## The honest killer question

**13. If nobody asked you to, would you keep using it next week?**
(Scale 1 to 5. 1: no, I would not. 5: yes, without hesitation.)

Answer:

**14. Why, or why not?**
This answer matters more than any other one on this page. Be blunt.

Answer:

## Anything else

**15. Anything we did not think to ask.**
A rough edge, a pleasant surprise, or a question you had that
`docs/FEEDBACK.md` did not answer.

Answer:
